parsing_repair_notes: 12 rows were affected by a PDF table-rendering artifact where the long airport name 'Ayodhya International Airport' caused pdfplumber to split the cell across two columns. The city_2 cell was truncated to 'Ayodhya International Airp' and the leading 'ort ' prefix from the continuation was prepended to the pax_to_city2 cell. These rows are deterministically repaired: city_2 restored to 'Ayodhya International Airport', passenger value extracted from 'ort <value>' prefix. All repaired rows have pdf_parsing_repaired=True. Verification: raw PDF text confirms correct values on every affected page.
dash_interpretation: The symbol '-' in the source PDF is used by DGCA to indicate zero or not-operated traffic on that direction. It has been preserved as NaN in the numeric columns and flagged via flag_city1_to_city2 / flag_city2_to_city1 = 'DGCA_DASH'. Do NOT automatically substitute 0 without confirming intent.

derived_fields.total_bidirectional_passengers: passengers_city1_to_city2 + passengers_city2_to_city1. NaN when either directional value is NaN.
